Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Nitinjay Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the impugned summoning order dated 27.10.2023 passed by Special Judge/Additional District and Session Judge,
Etawah passed in Special Complaint Case No. 581 of 2023, under Sections 323, 504, 506 and 392 I.P.C., P.S. Friends Colony, District Etawah.

entities.text:
Special Judge/Additional District and Session Judge,
Etawah
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is also prayed to stay the further proceeding of aforesaid case during pendency of the present application.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant No. 1 has solemnized the marriage of his daughter with Shivam Kumar but after some time in-laws of her daughter demanded dowry.

It is further submitted that when daughter of applicant no. 1 filed an complaint under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 and 354 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act wherein Shivam Kumar has been summoned to face trial under Section Manoj Kumar@ Raju And Anotehr vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33736587/
1 498A I.P.C. then in-laws of daughter of applicant No. 1 has filed a present false and fabricated complaint against the applicants.

entities.text: Section Manoj Kumar@ Raju And Anotehr vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PROVISION

sentences.text: The present complaint has been filed by opposite party No. 2 just to pressurize the applicant and his family members so that they may enter into compromise.

Lastly,
it is submitted that Section 392 I.P.C. is not made out against the applicants since there is only two persons.

4. Per-contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer and submitted that from the perusal of the material on record and looking into the facts of the case at this stage, it cannot be said that no offence is made out against the applicants.
The cognizance order has been passed after considering the evidence available on record, therefore, the present application deserves to be dismissed.
5. From the perusal of the material on record and looking into the facts of the case at this stage, it cannot be said that no offence is made out against the applicants.
The submissions made by learned counsel for the applicants relate to the disputed questions of fact, which cannot be adjudicated upon by this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C.

Moreover, the applicants have got a right of discharge through a proper application for the said purpose and they are free to take all the submissions in the said discharge application before the trial Court.
6. The prayer as made above is hereby refused.

7. However, keeping in view the facts of matter, it is directed that in case the applicants move an appropriate application for discharge within 45 days from today, the same shall be decided expeditiously in accordance with law.
For a period of 45 days from today or till the disposal of discharge application, whichever is earlier, no coercive process shall be taken against applicants.
8. The application is disposed of accordingly.
